description:
Pause or resume the RUNNING game, step exactly N frames, set the time scale, or list the live game instances. Step between two summer_game_probe reads for exact checks.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/game-control"}

action.description: 'pause' suspends the game (Engine time frozen, physics inactive); 'resume' lifts the suspension; 'step' advances exactly N frames and leaves the game suspended; 'speed' sets the user time scale;…

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

kind.description: action:'step' — 'physics' (default: exact physics ticks, max_physics_steps_per_frame pinned to 1) or 'process' (rendered frames).

speed.description: action:'speed' — user time scale in (0, 100]: 0.25 = quarter speed, 2 = double.

name: summer_game_control
title: Control the game clock
